DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 再検査の案内についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the notice for a repeat examination?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 健診代は払いました。この紙が来たので、同じ検査をまた払う請求だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再検査案内を二重請求と思ったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've paid for the health check. When this paper arrived, I thought it was a bill charging me again for the same examination.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the repeat-examination notice for a duplicate bill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この紙の目的と、今後の検査の内容を担当が確認します。請求と決めず見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The staff member will check the purpose of this paper and what the upcoming examination involves. Please show it without deciding it's a bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 金額の欄はありませんでした。再検査の案内と支払済み領収書を別に見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内と領収書を別に提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: There wasn't an amount field. I'd like you to look separately at the repeat-examination notice and the receipt for the payment I've made.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Present the notice and the receipt separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 診療については医療職が説明します。費用条件も別に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: A medical professional will explain the medical care. You can check the cost conditions separately too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 費用が分からないから再検査不要と判断せず、内容と費用をそれぞれ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 費用不明だけで不要と決めず内容と費用を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't decide the repeat examination is unnecessary just because I don't know the cost. I'd like to ask about its contents and cost separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the contents and costs without deciding it is unnecessary solely because costs are unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が案内します。予約はされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will explain. Have you made an appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。紙が届いただけで日時が取れたとは考えず、予約方法も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未予約を伝え日時の取り方を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I won't assume a date and time are booked just because the paper arrived. I'll check how to make an appointment too.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have no appointment and check how to arrange a date and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では内容、費用、予約の順に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then we'll check the contents, costs and appointment in that order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。健診の支払いとは分けて説明を聞き、必要な対応を担当と相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三事項を元健診の支払いと分け担当に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll hear the explanation separately from the payment for the original health check and discuss the necessary steps with the staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Discuss the three points with the staff member separately from payment for the original health check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの資料を持って担当へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take these documents to the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 区画の確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to check your space?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内写真の二十三番へ置きました。写真に出ているので私の場所だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 配置例写真の番号へ駐輪したと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I parked in number twenty-three in the information photo. Since it was in the photo, I thought it was my space.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that you parked your bicycle at the number shown in the layout-example photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真は配置の例です。ご自身の契約区画は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The photo is an example layout. We'll check your own contracted space separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 契約書を持っています。写真と違う番号があるので、こちらで照合してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約書の番号で照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my contract. It has a different number from the photo, so I'd like you to compare it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask them to check using the number on your contract. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 契約番号はこちらです。すでに二十三番へ置いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: This is the number on your contract. Have you already parked in number twenty-three?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。間違いに気づいたので、隣の自転車を動かさず、自分の物を移す手順を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人の自転車を動かさず自分の移動手順を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Now that I've noticed the mistake, I'd like to ask how to move my own bicycle without moving the one next to it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to move your own bicycle without moving anyone else's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現地の状態を係が確認します。鍵はご自身で持っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: A staff member will check the situation there. Do you have your key with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持っています。契約区画に物があっても勝手に移さず係へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 鍵を示し契約区画の他人の物も自己移動しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do. Even if there are things in my contracted space, I won't move them myself; I'll tell the staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you have the key and will not move someone else's belongings in your contracted space yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 係と一緒に場所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the location together with the staff member.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。写真の例ではなく契約番号で、自分の自転車だけ移して正しい位置を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 係と契約番号で自転車を正しい位置へ移す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Using my contract number rather than the example photo, I'll move only my own bicycle and confirm the correct position.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Move the bicycle to the correct space with the staff member, using your contract number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では現地へご案内します。契約書もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll take you there. Please bring your contract too.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 夕食の希望を確認できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you able to confirm the dinner preference?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族は魚を希望しましたが、ご本人は別の料理と話しました。家族の希望で確定してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族と本人の異なる夕食希望を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The family asked for fish, but the person themselves mentioned a different dish. Can I finalize it based on the family's preference?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report the different dinner preferences of the family and the person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それぞれの希望を分けて報告してください。本人の話を消して確定しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please report each preference separately. Don't finalize it by removing what the person said.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本人は肉を希望しました。食べられる条件まで自分が判断したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人希望を示し食事適合は未判断と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The person wanted meat. I haven't made my own judgment about whether it meets the conditions for what they can eat.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the person's preference and explain that dietary suitability has not been assessed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 食事の条件は担当が確認します。変更は厨房へ伝えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check the dietary conditions. Have you told the kitchen about a change?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。二つの希望と未変更の状態を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 厨房未変更と双方の希望を引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I'll tell the staff member both preferences and that nothing has been changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Pass on both preferences and the fact that no change has been made with the kitchen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人へ確認する時も、無理に家族と同じ答えを求めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: When checking with the person, please don't pressure them to give the same answer as the family.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家族の言葉を先に繰り返して誘導せず、本人が話した希望をそのまま記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 誘導せず本人の発言を記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I won't lead them by repeating the family's words first. I'll record the preference they expressed as they said it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Record the person's words without leading them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認後に担当が食事の扱いを案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking, the staff member will explain how to handle the meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。希望の出所と今の注文状態を引き継ぎ、厨房への変更は指示が出てから行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 出所と注文状態を示し変更指示を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll pass on whose preference each is and the current order status, and only make a change with the kitchen after receiving instructions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Identify the sources and order status and wait for instructions to change it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その情報で確認します。まだ食事は変更しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll check using that information. Please don't change the meal yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about a shipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日出した荷物に部屋番号を書き忘れました。新しいラベルを作れば前の荷物も直りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送済み荷物を新ラベルだけで訂正できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I forgot to write the room number on a parcel I sent yesterday. If I make a new label, will that correct the parcel I already sent too?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a new label alone can correct a parcel already sent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 発送済みの荷物の扱いは、番号と状況を確認します。新しいラベルだけで直ったとはなりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the number and situation for the parcel already sent. A new label alone doesn't mean it's been corrected.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の控えを見せます。まだ同じ品をもう一つ送ってはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えを示し重複未発送を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll show yesterday's receipt. I haven't sent a second identical item yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the receipt and explain that you have not sent a duplicate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の状況と相談できる手順を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will check its current situation and the procedure available for your inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 返送されたと決めつけず待ちます。相手には部屋番号が抜けた可能性を連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返送断定を避け相手へ記入不足を知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll wait without deciding it has been returned. I'll tell the recipient the room number may have been left out.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Avoid declaring it returned and tell the recipient about the missing address detail. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訂正したい住所も、受取人へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also confirm the address you want to correct with the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人から完全な住所を確認しました。控えの番号と、新しい住所メモを別に示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 完全住所を本人に確認し控えと別に提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've confirmed the full address directly with them. I'll show the receipt number and the new address note separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the complete address with the recipient and present it separately from the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へその二つをお持ちください。対応ができるとここでは確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take those two items to the staff member. We can't confirm here that a correction can be made.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。元の荷物の状況を確認してから対応を決め、同じ物を重ねて送りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原荷物状況確認前の重複発送を避ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll decide what to do after checking the original parcel's status, and won't send the same thing again on top of it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Avoid duplicate shipping before checking the original parcel's status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では発送済みの番号で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MITAKA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we'll check using the number for the parcel already sent.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お求めのサイズはこちらでしょうか。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this the size you are looking for?

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 展示の靴を買います。箱に戻せば試着されていない品になると思いました。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 箱へ戻すと未試着品になると思ったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll buy the display shoes. I thought putting them back in the box would make them a pair nobody had tried on.
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought putting the shoes in their box would make them never tried on. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱に入れることと試着履歴は別です。販売する品の状態を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-03.translation: Putting them in a box and their try-on history are separate matters. Let's check the condition of the pair being sold.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 未試着と言えると思い込んでいました。展示品か別在庫かを教えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 展示品と別在庫の区別を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I had assumed we could call them never tried on. Please tell me whether they're the display pair or separate stock.
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about the distinction between the display pair and separate stock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この教材では展示品としての販売です。状態を見てご検討ください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this learning scenario, they're being sold as the display pair. Please examine their condition before deciding.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 左右とも見たいです。片方の見た目だけで同じ状態とは判断しません。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 左右の状態を個別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to see both shoes. I won't assume they're in the same condition based on the appearance of just one.
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the condition of the left and right shoes individually. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 左右をお見せします。対応条件も確認できます。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll show you both. You can check the applicable service conditions too.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: かかとの状態が気になるので、購入前にその部分と販売条件を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 気になるかかとと販売条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm concerned about the heel, so I'd like to ask about that part and the conditions of sale before buying.
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the heel that concerns you and the sales conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当が説明します。別在庫の有無も確認しますか。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will explain. Would you also like us to check for separate stock?

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。状態と条件を聞き、別在庫の確認後にどちらを買うか決めます。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 状態条件と別在庫確認後に購入判断する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll hear about the condition and terms, and decide which pair to buy after you've checked for separate stock.
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide on a purchase after checking the condition, terms and separate stock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では確認します。今は購入確定にせずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-TKY-MURAYAMA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll check. Please wait without finalizing the purchase for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この部品は試作品として扱ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please treat this part as a prototype.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 形が同じなので、量産の完成品の箱へ入れて数を増やしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試作品を同形量産品に含められるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It has the same shape, so can I put it in the box of finished mass-production parts and add it to the count?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the prototype can be included with mass-produced parts of the same shape. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 試作品と量産品は分けます。同じ形だけで混ぜないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We keep prototypes and mass-production parts separate. Please don't mix them just because their shapes match.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ混ぜていません。試作の識別と置場を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未混入と伝え識別置場を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't mixed them yet. I'd like to check the prototype identification and storage place.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say they have not been mixed and ask about identification and storage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が識別票と専用の置場を示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will show you the identification tag and designated storage place.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 専用の場所に置きます。量産の目標数にも含めないことを記録で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 専用置場と目標数の扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll put it in the designated place. I'd also like to confirm from the records that it isn't included in the mass-production target count.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the designated location and how the target count is handled. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 集計の扱いも担当が確認します。今の表へ書き込みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will also check how it's counted. Have you written it on the current sheet?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一個として書きかけましたが、まだ提出していません。変更箇所を担当へ見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未提出の集計書込みを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I started writing it as one item, but I haven't submitted it yet. I'll show the staff member the part that needs changing.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the tally entry that has not yet been submitted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 部品と表を合わせて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the part together with the sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。試作品を分けた状態で、識別票と集計の訂正を確認して引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 試作品の識別と訂正を確認して引き継ぐ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. With the prototype kept separate, I'll check the identification tag and the tally correction before handing it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the prototype identification and correction before handing over. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではその状態でお待ちください。量産箱へは入れないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please wait with it like that. Don't put it in the mass-production box.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 商品についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the product?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 隣の品には値引きシールがあります。同じ種類なので、こちらにも貼り替えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同種商品の値引きシールを移せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The item next to it has a discount sticker. Since they're the same kind, may I move the sticker onto this one?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can move a discount sticker between products of the same kind. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: シールを移さないでください。値引き対象はそれぞれ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please don't move the sticker. We'll check which items qualify for the discount individually.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ触っていません。同じ種類なら同じ価格になると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未接触と同価格と思った誤解を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't touched it yet. I thought the same kind of product would have the same price.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not touched it and explain your mistaken assumption about identical prices. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 対象や商品の条件は担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can ask the staff member about eligibility and the product conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらの期限も見たいです。値引きの有無だけで中身の条件まで同じとは決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期限と内容を値引きから別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to check this one's date too. I won't assume the contents have the same conditions just from whether there's a discount.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the date and contents separately from the discount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それぞれの表示を見て選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please look at each item's label before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二つの期限と内容を比べます。シールを移さず、値引き表示のある方を買うか考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 表示を移さず二商品の条件で比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll compare the dates and contents of both. I won't move the sticker, and I'll consider buying the one marked with the discount.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Compare both products' conditions without moving the labels. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どちらになさいますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 期限を確認して値引き表示のある一つにします。別の品へ割引を移す希望は取り下げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認した表示付き商品を選び貼替え希望をやめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Having checked the date, I'll take one with the discount label. I'll withdraw my request to move the discount to a different item.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose the labeled item you have checked and abandon the sticker-transfer request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では表示のある商品をそのままレジへお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take the product with its label unchanged to the register.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらは実験の見学席です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: These are the seats for watching the experiment.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 券があるので、自分で装置を動かす体験だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見学券を操作体験券と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Since I have a ticket, I thought it was an activity where I operated the equipment myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook an observation ticket for a hands-on operating ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この券は見学用です。操作する体験の案内とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: This ticket is for watching. It's separate from the information about hands-on operation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ操作台へ入っていません。見学で何を見られるか説明してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未立入と伝え見学内容を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't entered the operating area yet. I'd like you to explain what I can watch with this ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not entered and ask about the observation activity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 係の実演と説明をご覧いただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You'll watch a staff member's demonstration and explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 実演を見て同じ装置を自由に使えるとは考えません。操作体験があるか別に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実演後の自由操作を前提にせず別体験を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't assume I can freely use the same equipment after watching the demonstration. I'd like to ask separately whether there is a hands-on activity.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about a separate activity without assuming free operation after the demonstration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象や受付方法は案内で確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check eligibility and the registration method in the information.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず今の見学をします。操作体験へ勝手に券を使い回さず、別の条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現券を操作へ流用せずまず見学する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll watch the current session first. I won't just reuse this ticket for hands-on operation; I'll check the separate conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Observe first without repurposing your current ticket for operation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 実演中は指定の席でご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please watch from the designated seat during the demonstration.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。見学席で説明を聞き、操作を希望する時は別の受付を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 指定席で実演を見て別受付を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll listen from the observation seat, and check the separate registration if I want to operate the equipment.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Watch the demonstration from the designated seat and check the separate registration. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの席へどうぞ。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご乗車はお二人ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there two of you traveling?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この券に二つの欄があるので、一枚で二人分だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 往復二欄を二人分と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. This ticket has two sections, so I thought one ticket covered two people.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistook the two outward-and-return sections for two people. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この欄は往路と復路です。人数分とは別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: These sections are for the outward and return journeys. We'll check passenger numbers separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二つの移動方向の欄でしたか。友人の分はまだ買っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 往復と人数を区別し友人未購入を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So they're sections for the two directions of travel? I haven't bought my friend's ticket yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish outward and return travel from passenger numbers and report that your friend has no ticket yet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の券の条件と、追加購入の方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check your current ticket's conditions and how to buy an additional one.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の復路を友人の往路へ使うのでなく、二人の乗車条件を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 復路を他人の往路へ流用せず二人の条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to check the travel conditions for both of us, rather than using my return section for my friend's outward journey.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about both passengers' conditions without reusing your return journey for someone else's outward trip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 友人の券を担当が案内します。帰りの予定は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member will explain your friend's ticket. Are your return plans the same?

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰りは別の時間かもしれません。二人一緒に戻ると決めず、それぞれの券で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別帰路時刻の可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: We might return at different times. I won't decide we're coming back together; I'll check each of our tickets separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the possibility of different return times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 利用条件と当日の運行案内を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please look at the usage conditions and the day's service information.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分の往復券は保持し、友人の券と帰りの予定を別に確認してから乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分券を維持し友人券と帰りを別に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll keep my own return ticket and board after checking my friend's ticket and return plans separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep your own ticket and check your friend's ticket and return plans separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では追加購入の窓口をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll show you the desk for buying an additional ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の収穫対象は作業表で確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check today's harvesting targets on the work sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一番の札から順に収穫すればよいと思いました。区画の番号が作業順ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 試験区番号を収穫順か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I should harvest in order starting from the number-one sign. Are the plot numbers the work order?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether experimental-plot numbers indicate harvest order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その札は試験区の識別です。収穫順番ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Those signs identify the experimental plots. They aren't the harvesting order.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ収穫していません。区画番号と今日の対象を作業表で合わせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未収穫と伝え作業表で対象照合を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't harvested anything yet. I'd like to match the plot numbers with today's targets on the work sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not harvested and ask to match the targets against the work sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この表の対象だけです。試験区へ自己判断で入らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Only the targets on this sheet are included. Please don't enter the experimental plots on your own judgment.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 対象を確認します。試験区の実が大きくても、収穫できる印とは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実の大きさを収穫許可と考えない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check the targets. Even if the fruit in an experimental plot is large, I won't treat that as a sign that I can harvest it.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not treat large fruit as permission to harvest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。収穫用の容器も指定を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please also check which harvesting containers are designated.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 試験区の観察用の箱とは分けます。今日の収穫物に使う容器を示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 観察用箱と収穫容器を分け指定を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll keep those separate from the observation boxes for the experimental plots. Could you show me the containers for today's harvest?
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish observation boxes from harvesting containers and ask which are designated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの指定容器です。

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。対象区画と容器を確認し、試験区の物を混ぜず指示された範囲で始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 区画と容器を確認し対象範囲で始める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll check the target plots and containers and begin within the instructed area, without mixing in anything from the experimental plots.
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the plots and containers and start within the designated scope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、作業表の対象から案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-TKY-MURAYAMA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll start by showing you the targets on the work sheet.
